ShortDescription.Value: Translates the mods you pick into your language: click a mod's window or options page and choose. 43 languages, translation memory, interface in 13 languages.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Auto Translate: Any Mod
**Many mods only speak English, or only their author's language. Auto Translate shows them in yours, automatically.**
Install it, start the game, and the mods you use appear in your language. Not only mods: any English text on screen that has no translation is translated too. The game's own translated texts are never touched.
## Features - **Translates other mods**: the localization of every installed mod that has no translation for your language, and the text mod panels and windows draw directly. - **Any untranslated text on screen**: text the game or a mod builds while you play, with no translation of its own. - **Never changes the game's own translations.** - **You choose what is translated**: by default only the mods you pick. Click a mod's window or its options page with the floating button and choose a language, and everything of that mod is translated: its windows and its options. Prefer the old way? Switch "What to translate" to **Everything** and every mod without your language is translated. - **Its own interface in 13 languages** (the game's twelve plus Arabic): it follows the game's language, your Windows language, or the one you pick. - **Picks the language by itself**: the game's language, otherwise your Windows language, or choose from **43 languages**, including languages the game does not offer (Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Ukrainian and more). - **Translation engines**: Free automatic (default: two free Google endpoints, switching when one refuses), Google, DeepL (your key), LibreTranslate (your own or a public server), Microsoft Translator (your key). - **Permanent translation memory**: every machine translation is saved in a local file and fully loaded at startup. Texts translated once appear instantly next time without asking the translator again, and no text is ever sent for translation twice. - **Floating button while you play**: drag it anywhere on the screen. Click it to: - turn translation on or off, and choose the language: automatic, the game's, Windows', or any of the 43; - see how many texts are translated and how many are waiting; - start the **click mode**: click any mod window and choose how that mod is shown: with the main translation, in its original text, or **translated into another language** (for example one mod in English, another in French, the rest in your language). Your choices are saved and listed in the button's menu, each with a button to reset it. - **Exclusions**: - Words and names that are never translated (for example a place name stays as written, even inside a translated sentence). - Whole mods left exactly as they are. - Editable on the Options page, in the click mode, or in ModsData/AutoTranslate/exclusions.json. - **Override files**: your own or community translations (JSON files in ModsData/AutoTranslate/Overrides/language-code/) always win over machine translation. - **Export untranslated texts** to JSON for community translators. - **Status panel**: engine, text counts, memory size and errors. - Placeholders such as {0} and {NAME}, numbers and tags are kept intact. - Light: idle cost is a few comparisons per frame; translation, saving and loading run in the background.
## How to use 1. Subscribe and start the game. Translation starts by itself in your game language (or your Windows language when the game is in English). 2. In a city, use the floating button (top right by default) to switch translation off or on, or to choose which mod windows are translated. 3. Options → Auto Translate: master switch, language, engine, floating button, exclusions, status and maintenance (clear memory, open the overrides folder, export untranslated texts, retranslate).
## Privacy With an online engine, **only the texts to be translated** are sent to the service you chose: never your city, saves or personal data. Each text is sent once, thanks to the memory. Override files and the memory never leave your computer. The free engines use unofficial endpoints that may limit or stop requests at any time. API keys are stored in plain text in the game's settings file.
## Good to know - Machine translation is not perfect; override files let you fix any text. - Excluded by default: Sign Builder: Saudi Edition and Arabic Street Names (they bring their own Arabic), and Auto Translate itself. - Safe to remove at any time: nothing is saved into your city.
## Support
**If you enjoy the mod and would like to support me:** [PayPal](https://paypal.me/MeshaalFayez). And don't forget to rate the mod here and star it on GitHub.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.0.0 - First release
- Automatic translation of other mods and of any untranslated text on screen, into 43 languages, with five engine choices. - Permanent translation memory (a text is never translated twice), master on/off switch, word and whole-mod exclusions. - Floating button: language choice, and a click mode to show each mod translated, original, or in another language. - Override files, export of untranslated texts, and a status panel.
